ran: subagentPromptCacheTtl with one Agent dispatch: user 5m vs project 1h (c5), project 1h vs local 5m (c6).
result: c5 sent 1h on the subagent request and c6 sent no ttl (5 minutes); the main request stayed at 5 minutes in both. The higher file won.
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call.
